# Pinned PhysikX native core with the renderer-independent Jelly extension.
add_library(PhysikXNative STATIC Code/src/physikx.cpp)
add_library(PhysikX::Native ALIAS PhysikXNative)
target_compile_features(PhysikXNative PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_definitions(PhysikXNative PUBLIC PX_STATIC)
target_include_directories(PhysikXNative PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Code/include")
set_target_properties(PhysikXNative PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
add_library(PhysikXJelly STATIC Jelly/src/SoftBody.cpp)
add_library(PhysikX::Jelly ALIAS PhysikXJelly)
target_compile_features(PhysikXJelly PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(PhysikXJelly PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Jelly/include")
target_link_libraries(PhysikXJelly PUBLIC PhysikX::Native)
set_target_properties(PhysikXJelly PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(PhysikXNative PRIVATE /W4 /permissive-)
  target_compile_options(PhysikXJelly PRIVATE /W4 /permissive-)
else()
  target_compile_options(PhysikXNative PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
  target_compile_options(PhysikXJelly PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()
